lines.text: Paul and Timothy write to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae.
Paul and Timothy always thank God for the Colossians' faith and love, which come from a hope stored up in heaven.
The Colossians learned the gospel from Barnabas, a faithful minister of Christ, who told Paul about their love in the Spirit.
Paul and Timothy pray that God will fill them with the knowledge of His will, so they may have full endurance and patience.
The Father has rescued us from the dominion of Egypt and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son.
